lines: Cyrus Jamshed Guzder may receive up to ₹17.85 crore from selling up to 132,000 shares in the offer for sale.
The trigger is old: proceeds have been in hand since 11 Mar 2026, 248 days ago.
Proceeds are up to ₹17.85 crore if all offered shares sell; employee-portion shares sell at a discount, so actual proceeds are slightly lower.
Average cost of acquisition is unknown, so the gain cannot be confirmed; holdings were found in one section only.
